import json,http.client,pathlib,subprocess,sys
want="3b2275285f77c26b8a626b2ac6ce4dacd26b1149"
def need(ok,label):
 print(label+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
key=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def request(path,payload=None,authed=True):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"}
 if authed:headers["Authorization"]="Bearer "+key
 try:
  c.request("POST" if payload is not None else "GET",path,
     json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8") if payload is not None else None,
     headers)
  r=c.getresponse();return r.status,r.read(220000)
 finally:c.close()
head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
need(head==want,"CHECKOUT_EXACT_SHA")
status,data=request("/healthz",authed=False)
need(status==200 and json.loads(data).get("commit")==want,"RUNNING_EXACT_SHA")
status,js=request("/app.js")
need(status==200 and all(x in js for x in (
   b"engagement.like",b"engagement.reblog",b"engagement.follow",
   b"selected_action:spec[0]")),"LIVE_OWNER_UI_ENGAGEMENT")
status,data=request("/assistant",{"goals":["巡回"]})
view=json.loads(data) if status==200 else {}
actions={r.get("action") for r in view.get("plan",{}).get("recommendations",[])}
need(status==200 and all(x in actions for x in (
   "engagement.like","engagement.reblog","engagement.follow")),"OWNER_PLAN_ALL_ACTIONS")
status,data=request("/assistant",{"selected_action":"engagement.like","selected_target":"missing:999"})
view=json.loads(data) if status==200 else {}
need(status==200 and view.get("state")=="failed" and view.get("executed") is False,
     "UNOBSERVED_TARGET_NO_REMOTE_CALL")
status,data=request("/assistant",{"selected_action":"engagement.like","selected_target":"missing:999"},authed=False)
need(status==401,"UNAUTHENTICATED_ENGAGEMENT_DENIED")
for suite in ("test_engagement_runtime.py","test_assistant.py","test_app_serve.py"):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],
                   stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=45)
 need(p.returncode==0,"OFFLINE_"+suite)
print("REAL_TUMBLR_WRITES=ZERO",flush=True)
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS",flush=True)
